tickets.title: Per-role concurrency caps queue extra jobs
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-22: a soft per-role cap on concurrently working jobs, adjustable in Settings; defaults imp 3, general 3, other roles uncapped (sonic children and headless sonic not counted). Counted machine-wide over jobs in a working state (not idle_grace/done/closed). hud_create for a role at its cap does not fail: the job is created as `queued` with its full brief and options, the result and notice say queued and its position, and the watcher starts the oldest queued job of that role when a slot frees (first available place at start time). The panel shows queued jobs with position; hud_close on a queued job removes it. A batch create queues the items past the cap. Overflow (owner 2026-11-22): an `imp` create at its cap starts as `general` instead when general has a free slot (the general role is the backup implementer, so Gemini and GPT load stay balanced and at most 6 implementers run); the result says it overflowed. Only when both are full does it queue. Overflow is a Settings toggle, on by default, mapping imp→general only. Spec §2.1.4 / §2.2 sentences drafted for the main session to tell the owner.

acceptance.text: With imp cap 3 and three working imps, a fourth hud_create returns queued and starts by itself when one settles
With three working imps and fewer than three generals, an imp hud_create starts a general and says so
Settings shows and changes the caps and the overflow toggle; a raised cap starts queued jobs at once

tickets.title: Headless sonic jobs started by a main session count toward the sonic cap
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-25 set `roleCaps.sonic: 9` to keep wide sonic fan-outs (e.g. 60+ transcript-labelling jobs) from exhausting RAM (14 GB machine, ~150-300 MB per pi process) and provider rate limits. Today `isCountedJob` (src/roles/concurrency.ts:25-29) excludes every headless sonic, so the cap never applies. Count top-level headless sonic jobs (no parent_job, not scout_only) toward the sonic cap like any other role; keep worker sonic children (hud_sonic) and prewalk scouts excluded so a worker or a target never waits on its own helper. Extra sonic jobs queue oldest-first and start headless when a slot frees, through the same queue path other roles use; make sure the queued-start path supports headless sonic launch (mode, thinking decision, limits). Keep the shipped default uncapped for sonic (only the owner's setting sets 9). Update docs/reference.md (+zh) roleCaps sentence.

acceptance.text: With roleCaps.sonic = 2, three main-session sonic creates: two run headless, the third reports queued with a position and starts headless when one settles
Worker sonic children and prewalk scouts still start immediately regardless of the cap
Default settings (no sonic cap) behave as today
Targeted tests for concurrency and sonic launch pass
